es.q: Discuss the general introduction and common types of paediatric solid tumors based on the provided text.
es.m:
- **Proportion of cancers:** Solid tumors account for about 30% of all cancers seen in paediatrics.
- **Improvement in outcomes:** Advances in diagnosis and treatment modalities have significantly improved mortality rates.
- **Future outlook:** The future is bright with advances in molecular genetics.
- **Common types and frequencies:** Brain tumours represent 22.3%, neuroblastoma 7.3%, nephroblastoma 5.6%, rhabdomyosarcoma 3.1%, retinoblastoma 2.8%, and osteogenic sarcoma 2.4% according to American cancer society data.
- **Local data comparison:** Local KNH figures show variations, such as nephroblastoma at 8.5%, retinoblastoma at 5.7%, and rhabdomyosarcoma at 5.2%.
